name: Polly L.
headline: Director of Partnerships | North America | Product Integrations
about:
I am a versatile professional with extensive experience in tech partnerships and business development, spanning from East to West. I thrive on collaborating with x-fn teams and external stakeholders to strategize, negotiate and deliver complex product partnership deals. As a strategic thinker and proactive go-getter, I find genuine fulfillment from building and growing impactful partnerships in both my personal and professional life.

My top 5 CliftonStrengths: Strategic, Achiever, Relator, Competition and Individualization.

experiences.description:
Promoted to Director to take on broader responsibilities across partnerships, I am responsible for strategizing and driving the development of key partnerships critical to Xero’s expansion in North America. I lead efforts to enhance our ecosystem and product offerings in Canada and the US, provide insights to senior stakeholders, craft strategic initiatives, and negotiate complex deals.

Also appointed as the leader for the global Partnerships Community to drive alignment, collaboration, and innovation across the ecosystem.

To build on the success and learnings from establishing the partnerships motion in Xero Asia, I transitioned to Xero Americas to lead the development and growth of our app ecosystem in Canada and the US through product partnerships. 

Delivered 30+ key integrations with app partners in the region to address Xero's product gaps and built a thriving ecosystem that continues to drive value for customers and partners.
